findings.claim: Malformed finding fields can escape the new evidence integrity check and crash both loop consumers instead of producing the structured integrity refusal.
findings.evidence: The helper validates only 'isinstance(f, dict)' and aggregate counts before evaluating 'sorted(f.get("obligations") or [])'. An executed, read-only in-memory probe supplied matching embedded metadata and counts with one open blocking finding whose obligations was 42; the helper raised "TypeError: 'int' object is not iterable". The CLI catches 'except SdleError as exc', so this exception bypasses review_evidence_invalid and the exit-3 JSON contract. Such evidence is malformed, outside the documented allowance for edits that remain valid and consistent.
findings.suggested_fix: Validate evidence finding fields against the findings schema before fingerprinting and convert invalid shapes to review_evidence_invalid. Add coverage through loop record and loop show for malformed fields with unchanged counts, asserting structured exit 3 and unchanged runtime files.
